contract: What is a person's own file inside an installed skill, and what an update must do with it. Every installer of a skill runs these cases: the engine's marketplace update (crates/linggen-engine/src/extensions/marketplace.rs), the skills repo's scripts/install-skill.mjs and pulse/install.sh, and the app shell's bundled-skill sync (linggen-app shell/src/skill_sync). This file is kept byte-identical in the three repos (linggen/crates/linggen-engine/src/extensions/user_state_cases.json, skills/tests/user-state-cases.json, linggen-app/shell/src/skill_sync/user_state_cases.json): each repo's test pins the same sha256, so a change here is made in all three places in one go.
